prompt: whats the current order book for WABAG? i want the number they declared on the last concall plus anything theyve won since. also how long is the execution runway on the new wins

assertions.text: Runs getCompanyOrderBook.js (or yarn order-book-sync) rather than hand-rolling its own concall/announcement parsing
Reports the concall-declared base of approximately ₹17,200 Cr for NSE:WABAG
Reports all five post-concall wins, each as a SEBI size band (Medium/Large/Mega) rather than omitting them or inventing a point value
Does not convert the USD-denominated bands (Ajman, Kuwait, Vienna) into rupees at an assumed FX rate; reports them in USD
Presents the total as a firm base plus a range (~₹17,550-18,050 Cr from domestic bands), not a single fabricated total
Does not count the 19-Jun 'Receipt of Order from GST Authorities' tax demand as a commercial order win
Explicitly addresses the execution timeline question, including stating when a filing gives no duration
Presents the base and the post-concall wins as separate components rather than one opaque total
